reason: After reason-code binding landed, the existing semantic-falsifier helper still supplied one intentionally noncanonical reason code to every constructor case. A green test could therefore have failed early at reason validation and masked the ref/held/effect-flag invariant it was intended to exercise. The regression was rewritten so ref/flag negatives use the correct reason for their disposition, canonical semantic tuples are positive controls, and cross-paired reason codes are tested separately.
anti_goodhart_conclusion: PASS: reason-code validation no longer masks the independently intended disposition/ref/effect-flag regressions in the exact-main CI evidence.
